name: In Nightmares
summary: A shard from the Wailing Caverns brings a troubling vision to Thunder Bluff. Recovered as a glowing fragment, the Nightmare Shard is carried to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on Elder Rise, where it reveals corruption within the Emerald Dream.

sections.title: A Disturbing Discovery
sections.body: Falla Sagewind sees the pure essence of the Emerald Dream in the strange crystal from the Wailing Caverns. A dark, chaotic vision dwells inside it, more waking nightmare than peaceful slumber. Unwilling to speak openly of such an omen, she entrusts the shard to you. She sends you to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem, Thunder Bluff's most venerated elder druid.

sections.title: A Secret in the Dream
sections.body: On Elder Rise, Hamuul Runetotem peers into the Nightmare Shard, and his composure falters. The shard gives him tangible evidence that the Emerald Dream is unraveling into nightmare. He urges discretion, warning that ordinary travelers cannot understand such delicate matters, and quietly resolves to investigate the affliction threatening the slumbering realm.

faq.answer: The Nightmare Shard is the glowing fragment recovered in the Wailing Caverns. Falla Sagewind entrusts it to you after examining it. Made from the pure spiritual essence of the Emerald Dream, it holds a foul, twisted vision that shows something has gone terribly wrong in the Dream.

Falla Sagewind is a knowledgeable tauren druid on the mountainside overlooking the Wailing Caverns in the Barrens. She studies strange phenomena from the corrupted oasis caverns and sends Horde couriers to Hamuul Runetotem when dangerous relics are found.

faq.q: Where can I find Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem?
faq.answer: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem resides on Elder Rise, one of Thunder Bluff's elevated mesas. He stands within the druidic circle with his fellow Cenarion Circle practitioners.

faq.q: Why does Hamuul want to keep the shard a secret?
aliases: why does hamuul hide the shard
faq.answer: The Emerald Dream is the sacred sanctuary of nature and the slumbering druids. Proof that it is being twisted into nightmare could cause panic among the Cenarion Circle and weaken fragile spiritual restoration efforts across Kalimdor, so Hamuul urges silence.

faq.q: Does the Alliance have a version of this quest?
faq.answer: Yes. Horde champions carry the Nightmare Shard to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff. Alliance investigators from the Wailing Caverns take their shard across the sea to Darnassus and present it to Mathrengyl Bearwalker of the Cenarion Circle.

faq.q: How does this relate to the Wailing Caverns?
aliases: how does this relate to naralex
faq.answer: The shard comes from the Wailing Caverns, where the druid Naralex entered a deep trance to channel underground springs into the Barrens. His slumber turned into a waking nightmare instead of healing the land, mutating cavern fauna and spreading into crystal shards like this one.

angles.text: For druids, the shard is alarming proof that the Emerald Dream's pristine sanctity is compromised. It confirms whispers of corruption creeping through Cenarion circles.

As a tauren, your return to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem reflects the growing prominence of tauren druids in the Cenarion Circle. They face ancient cosmological threats alongside their night elven teachers.

As a member of the Horde, delivering the shard helps safeguard central Kalimdor's spiritual well-being. It shows the Horde's crucial role in containing the fungal and dream-born corruption spilling from the Barrens.
